perspectives.headline: Single ticket bought in Illinois wins $1 billion Powerball jackpot
perspectives.excerpt: To the tens of thousands and likely more dreaming about a $1 billion Powerball win, the anticipation is over: Someone who bought a ticket in Illinois won it all. A single ticket sold in the state matched all six numbers and the Powerball to win Wednesday’s $1.04 billion jackpot, which is the eighth largest in the history of the lottery game, organizers said. The winning numbers were 4, 26, 66, 67 and 69, with a Powerball of 9.…

perspectives.headline: Powerball player in Illinois wins $1 billion jackpot
perspectives.excerpt: Powerball player in Illinois wins $1 billion jackpot It's the largest Powerball jackpot so far this year. A Powerball ticket sold in Illinois matched all six numbers in Wednesday night's drawing, winning an estimated $1.04 billion jackpot, according to the lottery organization. The winning numbers were 4, 26, 66, 67, 69 and red Powerball 9. It's the largest Powerball jackpot so far this year, and the eight-largest Powerball jackpot in the game's history.…

stories.headline: Голосование завершилось на первичных выборах в США на Среднем Западе
stories.headline_en: Voting ends in US midwest primaries
summary: Избиратели в шести штатах США выбрали своих кандидатов на первичных выборах.
Дэвид Кроули победил социалиста Франческу Хон в гонке за пост губернатора Висконсина.

perspectives.headline: Voting ends in US midwest primaries
perspectives.excerpt: Voters in six US states went to the polls to choose their preferred candidates in primaries and special elections ahead of November’s midterms. In Wisconsin, moderate David Crowley narrowly defeated Democratic socialist Francesca Hong in the race for governor. On the Republican side, Darline Graham, sister of the late Senator Lindsey Graham, advanced to a runoff in the Senate primary. Yuka Royer has the story.

perspectives.headline: Socialist fever breaks: Takeaways from Crowley's win
perspectives.excerpt: Milwaukee County Executive David Crowley narrowly defeated socialist Francesca Hong by about 3,000 votes, dealing a blow to the progressive left's momentum Tuesday in Wisconsin's Democratic primary for governor, after his own polling indicated he was behind by nearly 20 points. Why it matters: Crowley's win could breathe new life into a center-left that had been losing primary after primary in recent months, from last week's Senate contest in Michigan to House races across the country . perspectives.excerpt: Milwaukee County Executive David Crowley won the Democratic primary race for Wisconsin’s governorship, toppling his Democratic socialist opponent, Francesca Hong, who had surged in the polls leading up to Tuesday. What turned out to be a razor-thin contest wasn’t called by the Associated Press until early Wednesday morning, after a delay in tabulating votes from Milwaukee.…

summary: Пользователи Twitch раскритиковали платформу за разрешение использовать их контент для обучения ИИ Amazon.
Теперь Twitch позволяет пользователям отказаться от использования их контента для обучения моделей ИИ.

perspectives.headline: Twitch faces backlash over Amazon using content to train AI
perspectives.excerpt: Twitch faces backlash over Amazon using content to train AI - Published Twitch has been criticised by users after it emerged the popular streaming platform allowed their content to be used to train Amazon's artificial intelligence (AI) models. Amazon owns Twitch and a setting allowing the US tech giant to take data generated by creators and audiences to train AI is turned on by default.…

perspectives.headline: Twitch content has trained Amazon AI for years, but users can opt out now
perspectives.excerpt: Twitch now lets users opt out of Amazon’s use of content from their channels to train Amazon’s “generative AI content models.” The change, announced today, comes more than two years after a company executive confirmed that Amazon was using Twitch content for AI training.…

summary: Укроинские силы нанесли удар по российским терминалам в порту Новороссийск, убив троих человек.
Атака вызвала опасения по поводу глобальных поставок продовольствия.

perspectives.headline: Major Russian grain export terminals hit in Ukraine Black Sea port attack
perspectives.excerpt: Major Russian grain export terminals hit in Ukraine Black Sea port attack - Published A "massive" Ukrainian drone and missile strike on Russia's port of Novorossiysk has damaged two major grain export terminals and hit the last big Russian naval base on the Black Sea, reports say. Three people, including an eight-year-old child, were killed and another 24 injured in the overnight attack, local officials said.…

perspectives.headline: Ukraine attacks Russian grain export terminals in Black Sea, prompting warning about food markets
perspectives.excerpt: Ukraine has launched a heavy drone assault on warships and major Russian grain export terminals in the Black Sea port city of Novorossiysk, prompting Russia to warn of a disruption to global food supplies. Regional governor Veniamin Kondratyev said that three people were killed in the attack, including an eight-year-old, while another 24 were injured.…

Глава ВОЗ заявил, что текущая вспышка развивается с высокой скоростью.

perspectives.headline: Ebola outbreak on track to be deadliest ever, WHO chief says
perspectives.excerpt: Ebola outbreak on track to be deadliest ever, WHO chief says - Published The current outbreak of Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo is on track to surpass the deadliest outbreak of the disease ever, the director-general of the World Health Organization (WHO) has said. Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus told reporters that the 2026 outbreak, "at its current pace", would "eclipse" that of the 2014-2016 occurrence, which killed at least 11,000 people.…

perspectives.headline: Congo’s Ebola outbreak on track to surpass deadliest in history, WHO chief says
perspectives.excerpt: “At its current pace, it’s on track to eclipse the West African Ebola outbreak of 2014 to 2016,” WHO chief Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus told reporters on Wednesday. The World Health Organisation (WHO) has warned that the current Ebola outbreak in the Congo is on course to surpass the deadliest in history, which broke out more than ten years ago, claimed over 11,000 lives, and jolted efforts to develop a vaccine.…

stories.headline: Выборы в Замбии омрачены призраком соперника действующего президента
stories.headline_en: Zambia elections haunted by ghost of incumbent president’s arch-rival
summary: Замбийцы голосуют на выборах, где президент Хакаинде Хичилема стремится получить второй срок.
Оппозиционные партии пытаются воспользоваться недовольством избирателей по поводу роста цен.

perspectives.headline: Zambia elections haunted by ghost of incumbent president’s arch-rival
perspectives.excerpt: As Zambians go to the polls on Thursday, the ghost of the current president’s predecessor hangs over the elections. Hakainde Hichilema, 64, is bidding for a second term leading the southern African country after defeating his arch-rival Edgar Lungu by a landslide in 2021. A feud between the two men, their families and supporters has dominated Zambian politics, to the extent that the quarrel has continued even after Lungu died in South Africa in June 2025.…

perspectives.headline: Zambia heads to polls with President Hichilema expected to win second term
perspectives.excerpt: Zambians vote Thursday in a general election widely expected to give President Hakainde Hichilema a second term, as his economic record faces a test from voters frustrated by the cost of living and opposition parties seek to capitalise on discontent despite deep divisions.

perspectives.headline: BTS star V reveals hearing loss battle during livestream
perspectives.excerpt: BTS star V reveals hearing loss battle during livestream - Published V, a member of pop sensation BTS, says he has been receiving treatment for hearing loss in one ear, an announcement that comes midway through the band's highly-anticipated world tour. In a livestream on Wednesday, the 30-year-old said that he has dealt with the problem for about two and a half years. This was the first time he was revealing it to the band's fans, he said.…

perspectives.headline: BTS’ V Reveals Right-Ear Hearing Loss Amid World Tour
perspectives.excerpt: BTS member V told fans in a Wednesday livestream that he is being treated for hearing loss affecting his right ear, which he said now functions at roughly a third of the level in his left. He said he initially did not take the issue seriously, calling it “a matter of mental strength,” but is now taking medication and attending regular hospital appointments to manage it, according to BBC News.…

summary: 32-летняя женщина была спасена из-под завалов в Перейре после землетрясения магнитудой 7.4.

perspectives.headline: Woman pulled alive from rubble 36 hours after Colombia quake
perspectives.excerpt: Woman pulled alive from rubble 36 hours after Colombia quake - Published A 32-year-old woman, who had been trapped under rubble for 36 hours following the 7.4-magnitude quake which shook western Colombia, has been rescued alive. Daniela Largo was pulled from beneath a collapsed building in the city of Pereira after a 10-hour-long rescue operation. Firefighters finally managed to reach her via a tunnel they dug below four concrete slabs under which she had been buried.…

perspectives.headline: Colombia quake rescuers save woman after 36 hours trapped in rubble
perspectives.excerpt: Colombia’s earthquake rescue teams pulled a 32-year-old woman alive from the ruins of a collapsed building in Pereira on Tuesday, August 11, after she had been trapped for 36 hours. Daniela Largo Sánchez was brought out under a blue sheet to protect her privacy before being taken to an ambulance. Rescuers applauded as she emerged from the rubble, according to footage from the scene.…

stories.headline_en: At least 44 die as ferry sinks in Zimbabwe's Lake Kariba
summary: Паром, рассчитанный на 90 человек, перевернулся с 120 пассажирами на борту.
Полиция сообщила о 44 погибших, среди которых были дети.

perspectives.headline: At least 44 die as ferry sinks in Zimbabwe's Lake Kariba
perspectives.excerpt: At least 44 die as ferry sinks in Zimbabwe's Lake Kariba - Published At least 44 people have died after a ferry sank on Lake Kariba in Zimbabwe on Tuesday, police have said. The ferry had a capacity to carry 90 passengers and five crew members but a lake official had reported that 120 people, including 12 children, were on it. The vessel was hit by a strong wave and overturned, police added. Footage shared online appears to show the overturned hull floating in the water.…

perspectives.headline: At least 44 dead after overcrowded ferry capsizes on Lake Kariba in Zimbabwe
perspectives.excerpt: At least 44 people have died after an overcrowded ferry capsized on Lake Kariba in Zimbabwe, police said. The boat had a capacity of 90 people, but was carrying 114 adult passengers, five crew members and an unknown number of children, Zimbabwe’s civil protection unit (CPU) said earlier on Wednesday, citing ticket sales. A crew member told the national broadcaster ZBC that there were 153 people onboard when the ferry overturned on Tuesday after it hit large waves.…
